sub_service: Garbage collection complaint via Howrah Municipal Corporation's general contact channel
description: HMC's own domain (myhmc.in) confirmed to 403-block all automated requests across 2 rounds, including its 'Solid Waste Management' navigation link and static PDF uploads under wp-content/uploads (the block applies at the whole-domain/hosting level, not per-route). The Howrah district government's own domain (howrah.gov.in, genuinely separate infrastructure) publishes HMC's real head-office address, phone, and email on its Public Utilities listing -- but howrah.gov.in's own 'Solid Waste Management' page is a 'Coming Soon' placeholder, and its 'Citizen Charter' document category lists only unrelated state documents (District Environment Plan, Lakshmi Bhandar scheme), not an HMC-specific charter. No category-specific SLA for waste & sanitation was found on any reachable page.
procedure: Contact HMC's head office by phone or email; the source page offers no category-specific routing beyond this single general contact.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND for waste & sanitation complaints specifically -- the contact is real and confirmed, but no published numeric response/resolution time exists on any reachable HMC or district-site page for any category.
contact_information: Head Office: 03326383211. Email: citizen.care@myhmc.in. Address: 4, Mahatma Gandhi Road, Howrah, 711101.
